newsitem.title: USA: US Airways to sell Apollo stake for $154 mln.
newsitem.headline: US Airways to sell Apollo stake for $154 mln.

text.p: US Airways Inc said Tuesday that it has reached a non-binding agreement in prinicple to sell its 21 percent interest in the Apollo Travel Services Partnership to the Gallileo International Partnership for about $154 million.
The airline said it undertook the sale to enhance shareholder value, and said it will maintain an ownership stake, which it did not disclose, in Gallileo
Apollo Travel Services markets Galileo's computer airline, car and hotel reservation services in the U.S. Mexico and the Caribbean.
Galileo is owned by eleven airlines and has filed for an initial public offering.

It has already purchased the Apollo interests of United's parent compnay, UAL Corp, which owned 77 percent, and Air Canada, which owned two percent. In total Galileo is spending $700 million to buy Apollo.
